services.name: Childcare Matinee Series
services.desc: WT's Childcare Matinee Series makes seeing theatre easier to attend for parents and caregivers. Drop your young ones off at on onsite theatre class for ages 5-11 and enjoy a Sunday matinee performance. Our youth education workshops are designed to be active, fun, and adaptable for multiple ages and abilities. Young people ages 5-11 are welcome, and we ask that they be bathroom independent. PLEASE NOTE: Childcare Matinee tickets are only available to the corresponding matinee performance. Tickets are $10 per participant for subscribers and $15 per participant for single ticket holders - in addition to your ticket to the show. Questions about subscriptions? Call the WT Box Office.Questions
